# A dependency that predates modules carries no go.mod. The opt-in line lives
# in a module's own go.mod, so such a module has nowhere to write one and its
# directives do not run. The fetch says which line it wanted.
#
# The module cache sits inside the consumer's own module here, so the nearest
# go.mod above the dependency is the consumer's and not the dependency's.

env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/gopath/src/modcache

go mod download example.com/generatednomod
stderr 'example.com/generatednomod@v1.0.0 is outside github.com/wow-look-at-my/'
! exists $GOMODCACHE/example.com/generatednomod@v1.0.0/lang/lang.gen.go

# Nothing synthesized a go.mod for it either: the module directory holds what
# the zip carried and nothing else.
! exists $GOMODCACHE/example.com/generatednomod@v1.0.0/go.mod

# The package is what the zip published, which declares nothing.
! go build .
stderr 'lang.Name'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.16

require example.com/generatednomod v1.0.0
-- use.go --
package use

import "example.com/generatednomod/lang"

var Name = lang.Name()
